help.content:
========
Synopsis
========

Combines two datasets into a single paired collection (forward + reverse).

===========
Description
===========

This tool takes two individual datasets and packages them into a ``paired`` collection, labeling the first as **forward** and the second as **reverse**.

This is the inverse of **Unzip collection**, which splits a pair back into two separate datasets.

========
Examples
========

**Zip two datasets into a pair**

Inputs::

 Input 1 (forward):  reads_R1.fastq
 Input 2 (reverse):  reads_R2.fastq

Output ``paired`` collection::

 Paired: "reads (zipped)"

   forward  →  reads_R1.fastq
   reverse  →  reads_R2.fastq

-------

.. image:: ${static_path}/images/tools/collection_ops/zip.svg
  :alt: Zip two datasets into a paired collection
  :width: 500

-------

.. class:: infomark

This tool will create new history datasets copied from your input collections but your quota usage will not increase.
